text: {"lessons":["Selling winners early felt satisfying, but it may leave too little invested for future gains; I’ll use planned targets rather than the pleasure of locking in a profit.","Buying Stock C again and later selling it at a loss showed me that a recent price drop alone is not a reason to buy; I’ll require a clear investment case before adding.","After selling Stock A, I bought it back at a higher price. I’ll avoid reacting to short-term moves and follow a consistent plan for entries and position sizes."]}
